mailclient.howAndroid: (uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Gmail noma “Email”) — Engeza i-akhawunti → Okunye → Okomuntu siqu (IMAP) → ikheli nephasiwedi → bese kuba amaseva asethebulini. Uhlobo lokuphepha: SSL/TLS.

mailclient.howThunderbird: — Setha i-akhawunti ye-imeyili ekhona → igama, ikheli, iphasiwedi: ithola izilungiselelo ngokwayo. Uma kungenjalo, khetha “Configure manually” bese usebenzisa imininingwane esethebulini.

mcp.intro: I-MCP yizinga elivumela ama-ejenti e-AI (Claude, Cursor, izinhlelo zakho) ukuthi asebenze namasevisi angaphandle. I-ejenti enethokheni ingasesha futhi ifunde ama-imeyili akho nokunamathiselwe (kuphela okuhlolwe yisivikeli samagciwane), ibuke oxhumana nabo nekhalenda, futhi ilungise okusalungiswa. Ingashintsha futhi ithumele imilayezo kuphela uma uyivumela. Konke okwenziwa yi-ejenti kuyabhalwa.
